hypothesis: Deeper CNNs can learn more abstract features, leading to improved performance on image classification tasks
prediction: A CNN with 5+ layers, trained on ImageNet with ReLU activation and dropout, will achieve an error rate < 20%
measurement_method: Evaluate the CNN model on the ImageNet validation set
falsification_condition: If a 5-layer CNN, trained with ReLU activation and dropout on ImageNet, fails to achieve an error rate < 24%, the hypothesis is falsified
